Blue Ridge Sample Health Plan
Member Appeals Department
Date of this notice: April 20, 2026
Member ID: ******2468
Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
Member: SAMPLE MEMBER
Service requested: MRI of the lower back
Decision: Denied. The plan found that the service was not medically necessary.
You have the right to appeal this decision.
You must ask for an internal appeal within 180 days of the date of this notice.
To appeal, send the enclosed appeal form and any letters from your doctor to the Member Appeals Department.
Questions? Call Member Services at (804) 555-0199.
You may also ask for a copy of the rules the plan used to make this decision, free of charge.

summary_title: Your health plan decided not to pay for an MRI
summary_body: Blue Ridge Sample Health Plan decided not to pay for an MRI of the lower back. The letter gives a reason and says how to ask the plan to look again.

demands.text: The date of this notice is April 20, 2026.
The letter says to ask for an internal appeal within 180 days of the date of this notice.

demands.text: Phone for questions, from your paper: (804) 555-0199.

plan_steps.text: Call the number on the letter and ask which date your appeal must arrive by.
Gather the letter, the enclosed appeal form, and any notes from your doctor.
Ask your doctor's office for a letter that explains why you need the MRI.
A patient advocate or your state's consumer help program can help with an appeal.

glossary.explanation: Asking the health plan itself to look at its decision again.
Care the plan agrees is needed for your health.
A decision by the plan not to pay for a service.

questions_to_ask: What is the exact last day to send my appeal?
Can my doctor send the letter to you directly?
Can I get a copy of the rules you used for this decision?
